_doc: Kata of the karate training minigame (story 6.4, AD-20). lanes = the five tracks left to right; moves maps a kata token to its lane: L dodge left, R dodge right, H block high (up), D block low (down), K Kiai (. = a quiet step). belts.<id> = the kata set of that belt: stepsPerMinute = tempo of one step, windowScale scales the hit windows (higher belts are a little tighter, never harsh), kata = the three kata of a session in order (warm-up, kata, exam): steps = space separated tokens, speed = tempo factor of that kata. The last kata is the belt exam. windows = base hit windows in ms (perfect / good, linger = how long a missed note stays visible). fokus = the calm meter: a hit within steadyMs of the beat fills it by gain, a miss only drains missLoss, at the full level the hit windows widen by widen (share). scoring = points per grade with the combo multiplier (the minigame score is the share of notes hit; the exam uses grade weights: perfect 1, good goodWeight). play = leadInMs before the first step, gapSteps quiet steps between two kata, tailMs after the last one, fallMs = how long a note travels, resultMs = how long the exam banner stays before the result screen.
